body: I see a road rubbed out on the map, with six small figures beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper where I think they waited. The date is on the wrapper, not the map.
title: Map and pencil

body: I found a clipboard listing four vehicles and departure times. The eraser sits next to where a fifth line was removed. Small handwriting is still pressed into the paper there.
title: Clipboard and eraser

body: The sealed kit is tied to a towel marked for a passenger. The seat is crossed off, though the towel is still damp. There's a hurried thumbprint on the corner.
title: First-aid kit and towel

body: The loose page shows a different route than the map. Someone traced both with a finger stained from a lunch wrapper. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: Map and loose page

body: The battery is taped to a torch beside a handwritten departure time. I think the owner waited long enough to use up the spare. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Torch and battery

body: A badge and a band for counting arrivals are tied together. The band has an extra notch that isn't on the badge. The string has been retied since morning.
title: Badge and rubber band

body: The jack has fresh road grit and the wrench a strip of warning tape. The repair looks abandoned beside a penciled clearance time. The date is on the wrapper, not on the tools.
title: Jack and lug wrench

body: A frequency is scratched into the pencil's paint. The radio's label names another channel, and its paper says to wait. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Radio and pencil

body: Six names in the notebook, listed for pickup. The red pen adds one more but runs out before finishing. There's a thumbprint smudged in the margin.
title: Notebook and red pen

body: The bag holds an unused lunch wrapper. The map is folded to a stop crossed out twice. A child wrote the original time on the strap.
title: Schoolbag and map
